headline: Stock Exchange: Under siege from aggressive liquidations for a second day
summary: The Athens market extended its losses for a second day, falling below the 2,600-point support level. The decline of over 4% came as government bond sell-offs intensified internationally.
why: The Athens General Index tracks the main listed Greek companies, and its moves reflect both domestic sentiment and wider European risk appetite and bond yields.
why_moved: The report links the sell-off to a negative climate across Europe and an intensifying international sell-off in government bonds.
